title: DEG: Diffusion-Enhanced GFlowNet for Solving Vehicle Routing Problems
abstract: arXiv:2610.39512v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Traditional neural solvers for solving vehicle routing problems (VRPs) often suffer from limited solution diversity, motivating the development of Generative Flow Network (GFlowNet)-based models. However, the effectiveness of these models is frequently constrained by insufficient flow expansion in high-reward regions, limiting their ability to distribute probability across promising solution routes. Deeper exploration could yield superior results. Diffusion models, in contrast, provide stronger structural guidance for exploration. These two paradigms are naturally complementary: GFlowNet can supply edge-level signals for diffusion to embed, while diffusion can guide broader exploration. Leveraging this synergy, we propose Diffusion-Enhanced GFlowNet (DEG), a novel framework that integrates GFlowNet with a diffusion model to encourage richer flow expansion toward high-reward regions and derive higher-quality solutions. translated_abstract: 传统的用于求解车辆路径问题（VRP）的神经求解器往往存在解多样性受限的问题，这促使了基于生成流网络（GFlowNet）的模型的发展。然而，这些模型的有效性常常受到高奖励区域流扩展不足的制约，限制了它们在具有前景的解路径上分配概率的能力。更深入的探索本可以产生更优的结果。相比之下，扩散模型能够为探索提供更强的结构化引导。这两种范式天然互补：GFlowNet可以提供边级信号供扩散模型嵌入，而扩散模型则可以引导更广泛的探索。利用这种协同作用，我们提出了扩散增强GFlowNet（DEG），这是一种将GFlowNet与扩散模型相结合的新型框架，旨在促进向高奖励区域更丰富的流扩展，并获得更高质量的解。具体而言，DEG……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出DEG框架，将GFlowNet与扩散模型相结合，利用扩散模型的结构化引导弥补GFlowNet在高奖励区域流扩展不足的缺陷，从而生成更多样且更高质量的车辆路径问题解。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DEG, a novel framework integrating GFlowNet with a diffusion model, leveraging diffusion's structural guidance to encourage richer flow expansion toward high-reward regions and derive higher-quality solutions for vehicle routing problems.
